_comment: GH#429 THE WARDSTONE CHAIN, end to end. hedaults_wardstone shipped with no acquisition path: the GH#142 bead option yielded the fragment commission's product (hedaults_warded_setting) instead of its own, so the True-Set Wardstone -- and the mana_shield it carries -- were unreachable. Ruling 32(a) swapped the granted id and nothing else: 16-gold bead + 40-gold fee, base consumed, variant handed back. This run walks Hedault's shop from the landing cell (hedault_enchant_loop's own route, never pre-staged), reads the bead row's yield preview off the wardstone's real card, buys it, and pins the exact ledger. The fee/consume semantics are the pin that proves ONLY the id moved.

steps._comment: == THE WALK == the #423 route: up 3, left 4, bump north into (2,3) to face Hedault. The fixture lands on the shop's own landing cell, not beside him.

== THE PREVIEW == the panel derives effect_lines from the option's GRANTED id, so this row is the swap made visible: Resonance 2 and [Mana Shield], the wardstone's own card, where the setting's damage-reduction line used to read. Selectable here (bead held, 40 gold); its three siblings render visible-LOCKED behind their own gate labels.

options.text: The traveler's charm. Improve it. (20 gold)
The hunter's fang. Make it more than a trophy. (35 gold)
The wardstone bead. Set it true. (40 gold)
The guardian's fragment. I'm told you'd want to see it.

payload_contains.speaker: Hedault
payload_contains.text: Done. The work is correct; it is on the cloth and the fee is as quoted. Do not thank me or shake my hand. And keep it away from street enchanters afterward.

steps._comment: == THE LEDGER == fee exact and the base genuinely consumed. A swap that only ADDED the variant would leave the bead in the pack and the gold untouched -- both halves are asserted, not inferred.
